data.summary:
Three adjustments apply to this unit:

- **Wounding:** an attack aimed at this unit while its models have different Toughness values uses the value most of them share (the highest, if tied), and that holds for every attack the attacking unit makes.
- **Transports:** the unit may embark in any **TRANSPORT** it could otherwise enter, despite the **TERMINATOR**, **JUMP PACK** or **MOUNTED** keyword that models of these kinds carry in other units. Each Kill Team Terminator, Kill Team Outrider, Kill Team Biker and jump-pack model fills 2 model slots.
- **Terrain:** all of its models count as **INFANTRY** when interacting with terrain.
